name: qfd_n59_qbank9_b-qb9b-COMMIT
purpose: QW-N59-6 v9 (10-20): qbank5 RTL; N- AND S-face pins compacted (S dd_i 131-258) to the centre (131-392 um, 4.2/um) so every pin flop sits within ~130 um of the tile centre line (qbank5/6 N-face corner flops 555-598 ps vs S 452-491: the clock rule FAIL was geometric); Q-seat SRAM bank child of the hardened native59 split (Q.STA.N59): Codex N59v5 R3 source eab8ff8d2 with QB_LOCAL32=1 QB_ALIGN=1 (per-lane kept face control/predecode, third kept face publication); strict mapped native census PASS (all data/reset drivers <=32, 10596 FF / 8 SRAM, pins 0/0, ties 0, 405.1 ps lint depth; evidence 722cd9bda); zero added edges vs v4 (SOFF3/BOFF0/ROFF4); own root, landed into the parent by lp.py.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_native59_qbank #(.QB_ALIGN(1), .QB_LOCAL32(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_split/qfd_native59_qbank.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_32x512_m1/ot_sram_1r1w_32x512_m1_bb.v && echo lint-ok

bench.name: mut_mask
bench.cmd: N59_RECV=1 N59_RECV_MUT=0 N59_QB_ALIGN=1 N59_QB_LOCAL32=1 N59_QB_LOCAL_MUT=1 SPL_SOFF=3 SPL_BOFF=0 SPL_ROFF=4 SPLIT_ONLY=rnd_s1 bash rtl/test/qwen_split/run_native59_split_bench.sh {RUN}/bench/mut_mask

bench.name: mut_select
bench.cmd: N59_RECV=1 N59_RECV_MUT=0 N59_QB_ALIGN=1 N59_QB_LOCAL32=1 N59_QB_LOCAL_MUT=2 SPL_SOFF=3 SPL_BOFF=0 SPL_ROFF=4 SPLIT_ONLY=rnd_s1 bash rtl/test/qwen_split/run_native59_split_bench.sh {RUN}/bench/mut_select

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_n59_qbank9_b/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_n59_qbank9_b/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_n59_qbank9_b --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_native59_qbank --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_32x512_m1 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
